cvStructure.issue: The CV does not include a link to a GitHub profile, portfolio, or LinkedIn, even though the Projects section (ResNet-50 classifier, FastAPI/Docker service) would benefit from demonstrable, linkable work for an ML engineering role.
cvStructure.suggestion: Add a GitHub and/or LinkedIn link in the contact header so recruiters and ATS parsers can access the code for the Date-Palm Leaf Disease Classifier and Demand Forecast Service projects.

sectionOrganization.issue: The Skills section appears after Certifications near the bottom of the CV, which buries key ML-relevant keywords (PyTorch, scikit-learn, FastAPI) that are most important for an AI/ML Engineer target role.
sectionOrganization.suggestion: Move the Skills section up to directly follow the Summary or Education section so the relevant tools and libraries are quickly visible to both recruiters and ATS scanners.

keywordUsage.issue: The Summary mentions 'machine learning and computer vision' but never uses the term 'deep learning' or 'neural networks', even though the ResNet-50/PyTorch project demonstrates this exact experience.
keywordUsage.suggestion: Add 'deep learning' and 'convolutional neural networks' explicitly to the Summary or the Date-Palm project description to match common ATS search terms for ML Engineer roles.

readability.issue: The Summary is written in first person ('I enjoy turning messy data...'), which is inconsistent with the action-verb, achievement-focused style used in the rest of the CV.
readability.suggestion: Rewrite the Summary without first-person pronouns, for example: 'Computer Science graduate focused on machine learning and computer vision, experienced in turning messy data into working models.'

readability.issue: The College WhatsApp Help Menu and Physics II Lab Project bullets describe what was built but do not include any measurable outcome or result.
readability.suggestion: Add a brief result or scope detail to these bullets, such as how many students used the WhatsApp menu or the measured efficiency percentage of the transformer circuit.

contentFormatting.issue: Dates are formatted inconsistently across sections, for example 'Jun 2025 - Aug 2025' in Experience versus single years like '2026' in Projects and '2024 - 2025' in Activities.
contentFormatting.suggestion: Use one consistent date format throughout, such as 'Month YYYY - Month YYYY' or at least 'YYYY' consistently, so ATS systems can parse timelines reliably.
